title: Pure Trade creates Lancôme's festive The Suite Escape Palette
summary: For the 2026 holiday season, Lancôme entrusted Pure Trade Worldwide with the design and manufacture of the case for The Suite Escape Palette, dressed in a décor created by French artist Octave Marsal. The challenge for Pure Trade's teams was to give depth to this illustration of a Parisian palace hotel, the setting for an impromptu celebration.
